name: check_message_len / encode_checked / decode_checked

test_list.description: A length equal to the limit passes.
limit + 1 fails with Oversize carrying the length and the limit; usize::MAX does not overflow.
The same length passes under a larger limit and fails under a smaller one.
An empty message is accepted, even with limit 0.
MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES is 1 MiB, MAX_CHUNK_BYTES is 896 KiB and a chunk plus its framing overhead stays under the message limit.
A message whose encoded length exceeds the limit is refused by encode_checked; one that fits encodes to the same bytes as prost.
Input longer than the limit is refused without decoding; input at the limit decodes; garbage within the limit is a Decode error, not a panic.

inputs.name: len
inputs.description: Length in bytes of an encoded message or stream chunk.

output_description: Ok when len <= limit, otherwise Oversize { len, limit }.
